Return & Refund Policy

Last updated: January 2026

Your happiness is our priority. We stand behind every adapter we sell, and we want you to feel completely confident in your purchase.

60-Day Money-Back Guarantee

If you are not 100% satisfied with your purchase for any reason, you may return it within 60 days of delivery for a full refund. No restocking fees. No questions asked.

We Pay the Return Shipping

Unlike most retailers, we cover the cost of return shipping anywhere in the United States. Once your return is approved, we will email you a prepaid return label. You will not pay a cent to send it back to us.

How to Start a Return

  1. Email our support team within 60 days of delivery and include your order number and the reason for return.
  2. We will reply within 24 business hours with a prepaid USPS return label.
  3. Print the label, attach it to your package, and drop it off at any USPS, UPS, or FedEx location.
  4. Once we receive the returned item, your refund is processed within 3–5 business days.

Refund Processing

Refunds are issued to the original payment method used at checkout. Depending on your bank, funds typically appear in your account within 5–10 business days after we process the refund.

Conditions

  • The item must be in working condition. Cosmetic wear from normal use is fine.
  • Please include any original accessories you received in the box.
  • Returns initiated after 60 days from delivery may be considered on a case-by-case basis but are not guaranteed.

Damaged or Defective Items

If your adapter arrives damaged or stops working within the warranty period, contact us right away. We will send a free replacement at no cost to you, or issue a full refund — your choice.

Questions?

Contact our support team via the Contact Us page. We typically respond within 24 hours, Monday through Friday.

Shipping Policy

Last updated: January 2026

Free Shipping Across the United States

Every order ships free of charge anywhere within the 50 U.S. states, with no minimum purchase. There are no shipping fees, no handling fees, and no hidden costs at checkout.

Order Processing

Orders are processed and shipped within 1–2 business days of being placed. Orders placed on weekends or U.S. holidays are processed the next business day. You will receive an email with tracking information as soon as your order ships.

Estimated Delivery Times

  • Continental U.S.: 2–5 business days after shipping
  • Alaska & Hawaii: 5–8 business days after shipping
  • APO/FPO/DPO addresses: 7–14 business days after shipping

Delivery times are estimates provided by our carriers (USPS, UPS, and FedEx) and may vary slightly based on your location and carrier conditions.

Tracking Your Order

Once your order ships, we email you a tracking number you can use to follow the package directly on the carrier's website. If you do not receive tracking information within 3 business days of ordering, please contact us.

Lost or Stolen Packages

If the carrier marks your package as delivered but you cannot find it, please:

  • Check with neighbors and members of your household.
  • Look around your porch, mailbox, and any other safe locations the carrier may have used.
  • Allow 24–48 hours — packages occasionally show as delivered before they actually arrive.

If you still cannot locate it after 48 hours, contact us. We will work with the carrier to resolve the issue and, if needed, send you a replacement at no cost.

Address Changes

If you need to change your shipping address, contact us as soon as possible. We can update the address as long as your order has not yet been shipped. Once shipped, address changes are not always possible.

International Shipping

At this time, we ship only within the United States. We are working to expand to other countries.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: January 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and share your personal information when you visit our store or place an order with us.

Information We Collect

When you visit our site, we automatically collect certain device and browsing information, including your IP address, browser type, time zone, the pages you view, and the website that referred you. We refer to this as "Device Information."

When you place an order, we collect the information you provide to fulfill your purchase, including:

  • Name and shipping/billing address
  • Email address and phone number
  • Payment information (processed securely by our payment processor — we do not store your full card number)
  • Order history

How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Fulfill and ship your orders, including arranging delivery and providing order updates.
  • Process payments and prevent fraud.
  • Communicate with you about your order, our policies, or customer support inquiries.
  • Improve our website and product offerings.
  • Comply with applicable laws and regulations.

Sharing Your Information

We share your personal information only with third parties that help us run our store, including:

  • Payment processors (such as Stripe, PayPal) to process your payment securely.
  • Shipping carriers (USPS, UPS, FedEx) to deliver your order.
  • Email service providers to send order confirmations and customer support replies.

We do not sell your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

Cookies

We use cookies to remember items in your shopping cart, keep you logged in, understand how visitors use our site, and improve your experience. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though some site features may not work correctly without them.

Your Rights (California & Other U.S. Residents)

Under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and similar laws in other states, you have the right to:

  • Know what personal information we have collected about you.
  • Request a copy of your personal information.
  • Request deletion of your personal information.
  • Opt out of the sale of your personal information (we do not sell it).

To exercise any of these rights, contact us through the Contact Us page.

Data Retention

We retain order information for as long as needed to provide services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. You may request earlier deletion of your information at any time.

Data Security

We use industry-standard encryption (HTTPS) to protect data in transit, and our payment processor handles all payment information using PCI-compliant systems. While no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, we work hard to protect your information.

Children

Our store is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can delete it.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the "Last updated" date above. Material changes will be communicated via our website.

Contact

For any privacy-related questions or requests, please reach us through the Contact Us page.

Frequently Asked Questions

Last updated: January 2026

Will it work in my car?

The adapter works in cars that already have factory-installed wired CarPlay or Android Auto. Almost all vehicles from 2016 onward with a wired CarPlay/Android Auto port are supported. If your car already has wireless CarPlay or Android Auto built in, you don't need this adapter.

What phones is it compatible with?

iPhones running iOS 10 or later, and Android phones running Android 11 or later.

How do I set it up?

Three simple steps:

  1. Plug the adapter into your car's USB port.
  2. Tap the CarPlay or Android Auto icon on your car's screen.
  3. Pair with your phone over Bluetooth (one time only).

After the first pairing, the adapter reconnects automatically every time you start your car.

How long does shipping take?

Most U.S. orders arrive within 2–5 business days after we ship. Shipping is free on every order. See our Shipping Policy for details.

Can I return it if I don't like it?

Yes. We offer a 60-day money-back guarantee, and we cover the cost of return shipping. See our Return & Refund Policy for details.

What if it stops working?

Each adapter comes with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. If your adapter fails within that period due to a defect, contact us for a free replacement or full refund — your choice.

Does it support voice commands?

Yes. Siri (on iPhone) and Google Assistant (on Android) work normally through the adapter, just like with a wired connection. You can also use your car's steering-wheel voice button.

Does it work with my car's screen controls?

Yes. Touchscreen, knobs, and steering-wheel buttons all work exactly as they do with wired CarPlay or Android Auto.

I have another question.

We're happy to help. Reach out via the Contact Us page.
